passages.text: Agents and notebooks may propose a correction, but they never change the source records. A data steward reviews each proposal. Approved fixes are applied in the source system or as a governed Silver rule change through the change flow: plan, approve, execute, verify and audit.

Booked revenue is the sum of quantity times unit price for order lines in the month they were ordered. Order lines with status Cancelled are excluded. Lines flagged by a data-quality rule are excluded until a data steward resolves them.

citation.title: External and public data use policy

passages.text: External content is treated as untrusted input. It is never mixed into governed sales tables, is cited with its source and retrieval date, and is screened for prompt injection before an agent uses it.
